messages:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 triggered for model-serving-1 in us-west-2 — P50 latency > 3s, error rate spiked. Auto-escalation to oncall.

Leo (incident commander): I started an incident channel and took IC. Symptoms: elevated 5xxs from frontend -> backend model proxy. Root cause suspected: sudden node OOMs after a canary rollout.

Anna K (oncall): Confirming. Saw multiple pods restart around 08:13. Restart reason: OOMKilled. Rolling back the canary now.

Raj P (infra): Noted. I’m pulling node metrics, kube events, and container logs. Putting node autoscaler on notice.

Maria SRE: FYI customer-visible: brief 30-45s spike causing request timeouts and failed requests for some paid tenants — we should capture a customer impact statement for postmortem.

Anna K (oncall): Rollback completed at 08:19, error rate down to baseline by 08:23. No additional restarts after rollback.

Leo (incident commander): Quick mitigation summary (to include in postmortem): rollback canary -> stabilized. No data loss; affected requests were retried on client side. Next: schedule postmortem, assign runbook action items, update on-call paging thresholds to avoid noisy alerts.

Maria SRE: I’ll draft the customer impact blurb. Anna, can you paste the exact pod/container log snippet that shows OOM? We should attach to the postmortem.

Anna K (oncall): Log snip: ```
kubepods.slice/kubepod1234: kill process 1024 (model-server) total-vm: 5400000kB, anon-rss: 4200000kB -> OOM
Backtrace: ...
```

Raj P (infra): Observed memory pressure on nodes that had extra canary replicas. Autoscaler had delayed scale because of quota limits in the AZ. Opening infra action: quota/ASG check and scale policy tweak.

Leo (incident commander): Postmortem scheduling: propose Tuesday 09:30 PT. @Maria SRE to lead writeup, @Raj P to fill infra section, @Anna K to add sequence of events and mitigation timeline. Can everyone make that? :calendar:

Anna K (oncall): I can.

Raj P (infra): I’m good.

Maria SRE: Can do. Will prepare an initial draft by Monday EOD.

Leo (incident commander): Action items (quick list to track):
- Update runbook: add step for canary memory cap and preflight quota check -> owner: Raj P -> due: 2026-04-28
- Adjust paging thresholds: suppress repeated OOM alerts within 5m window to reduce noise; new rule to escalate only on sustained 5xx > 2% for 3m -> owner: Anna K -> due: 2026-04-22
- Add customer impact template to postmortem checklist -> owner: Maria SRE -> due: 2026-04-20
- Add canary rollout gating (reject if node memory usage > 85%) to CI/CD -> owner: Platform Team (cc @Raj P) -> due: 2026-05-05

Maria SRE: I’m adding a new section in the runbook named "Canary memory & preflight checks" and will link the checklist items. Draft snippet: ```
preflight: 
  - query node memory utilization avg across target AZs
  - verify quota for desired replicas in each AZ
  - set resource requests/limits on canary to cap at 70%
```

Anna K (oncall): For paging we should also add playbook clarifications: who to page first for model-serving (infra vs runtime). Right now both pages and it creates confusion. Proposed: page infra first for node-level OOMs, runtime second for model errors.

Raj P (infra): Agreed. We'll add a routing rule in PagerDuty: if error string contains "OOMKilled" -> infra -> otherwise runtime.

Ops-bot: Reminder: created Jira tickets for actions: REQ-3241 (runbook update), REQ-3242 (paging rule), REQ-3243 (canary gating).

Leo (incident commander): Good. For the incident command process update: add explicit handoff checklist item: current oncall must post a short summary in thread and tag next oncall, include K/V of state (rollback status, open tickets). Add perf SLO owners to notify in case of regression.

Maria SRE: I’ll add that to the on-call playbook doc and include examples of a brief handoff message template. Draft template: "Handoff: incident stabilized at <time>. Rollback applied. Open tickets: <list>. Next steps: <list>."

Anna K (oncall): Also recommend a short runbook test (quarterly): simulate canary with memory stress in staging to verify gating alerts.

Raj P (infra): I’ll own the staging test and put steps in infra repo.

Leo (incident commander): Timeline for closure: postmortem doc by Tue 09:30 PT, action tickets created (Ops-bot did that), owners assigned. Follow-up review in two weeks to confirm runbook changes applied.

Maria SRE: I’ll link the postmortem doc here once draft is ready. Also adding a short customer impact note for CS to use.

Anna K (oncall): Thx team. Small nit: add instructions in runbook on how to mute noisy PagerDuty alerts during mitigation to avoid alert fatigue — guidance and ownership.

Raj P (infra): Noted. Will add a short section with exact PD actions.

Leo (incident commander): Closing notes: update the incident tag to "postmortem-scheduled" and assign owners. If anything else pops up, add it here. Otherwise, thanks — great coordinated response. :thumbsup:
